title: A prompt-to-image project joins Creative Projects
summary:
Two image generators joined Creative Projects, and the text API root now points to documentation.

Rishabh Mishra’s React-based image generator was added to the Creative Projects listing, with style, quality and resolution controls plus image history.

CVRON AI was added to Creative Projects with a Turkish language tag and an English translation of its description.

The root of text.pollinations.ai now redirects to API documentation instead of the community UI.
